<function name="SpawnlistOpenGenericMenu" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>
<internal>Use <page>SANDBOX:SpawnmenuIconMenuOpen</page> if you wish to add new options to spawnmenu icon right click menus.</internal>
Called when there's one or more items selected in the spawnmenu by the player, to open the multi selection right click menu (<page>DMenu</page>)

</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg type="Panel" name="canvas">The canvas that has the selection. (<page>Panel:GetSelectionCanvas</page>)</arg>
	</args>
</function>
